about: The image generators' models and list prices (dollars per picture of about one megapixel, by quality where the model has qualities), checked on the providers' own pages on 2026-11-07: developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing and /guides/image-generation, aistudio.google.com/docs/pricing, bfl.ai/pricing, openrouter.ai/api/v1/images/models/<model>/endpoints. Where a picture's price depends on its shape, the higher one. A model without a price here costs what its provider says, which a talk's estimate can't tell beforehand. Models come and go (several were retired in 2026, OpenAI's gpt-image-1 on 2026-10-23), so a model is named in TALKGENERATOR_IMAGE_GENERATOR or --image_generator, and these are the defaults; image_generators.json in talkgenerator's config folder adds to this file, or changes it.
